description:
FILED s543n (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24) while probing #2594 (the pipe close's wait status).  PRE-EXISTING (base 617d66c8 = tree).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | PCL):
    system("sh", "-c", "exit 6"); print ${^CHILD_ERROR_NATIVE} // "undef", "\n";
    perl: 1536      PCL: undef
The emitter declares `(defvar |${^CHILD_ERROR_NATIVE}| (make-p-box nil))` in the program's package; the runtime has
no such variable.  perlvar: "the native status returned by the last pipe close, backtick command, successful call to
wait() or waitpid(), or from the system() operator" -- on POSIX the same number as $? at that moment, but NOT changed
by an assignment to $? or by END.  The reaping sites all store through %p-set-status; the variable would be an
exported magic box over a native-status cell that only those sites write.
frequency_reason: ${^CHILD_ERROR_NATIVE} (first pass from the subject, the reviewing session 2026-11-24)
subject: SILENT WRONG: `${^CHILD_ERROR_NATIVE}` is never set -- it reads undef after system / backticks / a pipe close / waitpid (perl: the native wait status, 1536 after `system("sh", "-c", "exit 6")`)
triage_reason: a silent wrong: a documented perl variable reads undef where perl has the child's status: IN
